info.title: LaunchKit.AspNetCore.Tools
info.description: Cross-platform CLI for LaunchKit.AspNetCore. Scaffolds legal pages, custom error pages, ASP.NET Core error handling, sitemap.xml and robots.txt into an ASP.NET Core MVC project. Visual Studio users can use the Add-LaunchKit command from the LaunchKit.AspNetCore package instead.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Launch essentials for ASP.NET Core MVC, scaffolded by one command.

options.description: Display name of the site used in the generated legal pages.

options.name: --email
options.description: Contact address printed in the generated legal pages.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report every change without writing anything.

options.description: Use ASCII markers instead of Unicode.
